title: Goodbye to the Old Lady
summary: On Friday, May 15, 2015, after completing final exams with a 4.0 GPA and graduating from Cardiac Rehab, the nine residents pack up Suite 214/216 in Bennett Hall. Once Jordan turns in his room key—officially ending Isabel Dawson's tenure as his Resident Advisor—he and Isabel share a long, deep goodbye hug in the second-floor hallway before the family rolls out to prepare for the Summer 2015 World Trek.
